# PS Almenpsykiatrisk, Nord Ambulatorier

PS Almenpsykiatrisk, Nord Ambulatorier is a Danish outpatient psychiatric unit ("almenpsykiatrisk ambulatorium") tracked within the ADHD-databasen, the national Danish quality registry for ADHD treatment. It appears in the ADHD_2024 report as one of the local units measured against national quality indicators for adult ADHD treatment [^src1][^src2].

The unit's most notable result concerns Indicator 10, which measures the share of adult treatment courses in which the patient's need for social support was assessed within 120 days of starting treatment. PS Almenpsykiatrisk, Nord Ambulatorier scored only 22 out of 126 eligible cases, corresponding to 17% (confidence interval 11–25%) [^src1]. This is far below the national quality target of 90% completion, and also below the national average of 37% reported for this indicator, which itself was published for the first time in this report and revealed widespread shortfalls across Denmark, with regional results ranging from 14% to 52% [^src1]. The steering group behind the ADHD database discussed possible causes for the low completion rates, including registration practices and gaps in data from child and adolescent psychiatric outpatient clinics and private hospitals, and decided to work on improving registration practices going forward [^src1].

By contrast, the same unit performed much better on a separate measure: 106 of 126 cases (84%, confidence interval 77–90%) met the relevant benchmark reported on page 56 of the same document [^src2]. This page range corresponds to Indicator 11, which tracks the share of adult patients who were in treatment with ADHD medication within 120 days of the start of a structured treatment package ("pakkeforløb"). This was the first time Indicator 11 was compiled for adults, following the 2024 expansion of the ADHD database to include adult patients, and the national results showed considerable regional variation — for example Region Nordjylland reached 85% while Region Hovedstaden reached only 37% — variation the report attributes primarily to differences in registration practice rather than genuine differences in clinical care [^src2].

Together, these two data points show a unit that struggled markedly with formally documenting patients' social support needs (Indicator 10) while performing comparatively well on ensuring patients received timely ADHD medication (Indicator 11).

## Claims

- PS Almenpsykiatrisk, Nord Ambulatorier achieved 17% (22 of 126, CI 11–25%) fulfillment of Indicator 10, well below the 90% development target [^src1].
- PS Almenpsykiatrisk, Nord Ambulatorier achieved 84% (106 of 126, CI 77–90%) on the metric reported alongside Indicator 11 [^src2].
